scope: Native whole-world static-model visual ownership in ordinary paged worlds. Scoped coverage/mutation/persistence verification, not universal seamless LOD, new proxy art, or whole-project completion.
implementation: Original native code using existing registered static-model meshes/materials/imported LODs and the existing checked archive worker. No save schema, generator, canonical-world or new worker changes.

contract.collision: Existing local canonical collision only; distant visual reads do not hydrate editable models.
contract.mutation: Authored upsert/removal/history/native prefab hooks, reset epochs and bootstrap overrides. Canonical admission/retirement preserves visual ownership.
contract.pressure: Explicit not-ready state; bounded authored-change retries allow removals to recover capacity. Failed reset seeds cannot report the new epoch ready.
contract.limits: Planning charge is not total allocator/mesh/driver memory. Collection reset/destruction are not fully sliced. No new mesh LODs are fabricated; existing source resources remain authoritative.

pressure.prototype: Shared BoxMesh, not 100000 complex authored props.

lifecycle.scope: Real terrain worker manual save, autosave, rejected capture, reload, shutdown/fresh scene, reset. Includes full visual counts and persisted edited pose.

installed_world.scope: Complete registered-prop IDs, actual GPU pose, distant close camera, real canonical admission, authored update/restore; no physical-driving or continuous-zoom qualification.

prior_installed_world.scope: Before final failed-seed epoch guard; timing variation is not a claimed loading speedup.

vehicle_regression.scope: Prior combined DLL before final failed-seed epoch guard; populated four-Ranger ownership and second-world play gate.

forest_regression.scope: Final installed cold/warm world retains every tree identity through real block admission/retirement, harvest, excavation and rebuild; teardown releases exclusion pages and source save is unchanged. Loading controller logs include a 134 ms hitch; this is not a whole-loading frame-time pass.

doors.scope: Temporary-world placement, description, native interaction and salvage run offscreen without mouse capture. Does not replace the door chat's separate isolated physical E/HUD evidence; headless pack check has no VRAM sample.

retained_failures.cause: New fixture put an attachment outside its prefab envelope and attempted atomic deletion of an already-removed identity. Corrected fixture; production validation was not weakened.
New play gate incorrectly required an absent model horizon in a nonpaged temporary scene. Gate now applies only when the paging coordinator exists; normal saved worlds still require coverage.

42 admission correctness checks passed, but concurrent-world-run step timing exceeded the existing 2 ms ceiling (2.322/3.637 ms). Sequential repeat retains the same threshold and peaks at 0.679 ms. Not universal thermal/frame-time qualification.

retained_failures.scope: Shared build initially encountered a DLL lock while the authorized door chat tested the same checkout. Builds were separated; door source commit 17398657 was integrated before combined rebuild/export.

fixture.policy: Read-only populated fixture; final SHA verified unchanged. Lifecycle fixtures are separate owned saves.

measurement: Windows per-process private-commit/dedicated-GPU counters sampled at 0.5 s on RTX4050 laptop; not instantaneous peaks, whole-device use or physical 4 GiB compatibility.
